_source: Keys captured from kan's own .kan/log/repo.car at 448 claims. The expected_root is NOT our reading of the spec: it is the output of @atproto/repo 0.10.10 (the TypeScript reference implementation) over exactly these pairs, cross-checked by an independent Python implementation that agrees on root CID, node count and total bytes.
_why: atproto-repo 0.14.5's MST never split, so every repo it wrote had a root CID no conformant implementation agrees with (kan#204). Reachability testing per ADR-11/12 cannot catch this: nothing is lost, the tree is just wrong. This fixture is the structural check that can.
